workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Direct BRep

authority_chain.selection: OLEANDER geometry-rule selectors re-resolved per authoritative revision

bounded_scope: geometry-rule vertical straight outer-edge selector without persisted EdgeN handles
geometry-rule unique top planar face selector without persisted FaceN handles
bounded multi-edge fillet over selected vertical edges
bounded multi-edge chamfer over selected vertical edges
bounded inward thickness/shell with selected top face removed
80 mm to 100 mm authoritative width rebuild
selector sets are re-resolved independently for each revision
fillet chamfer and shell rebuild after authoritative width change
single-solid and shape-validity checks for base and all three operations
normalized-shape validity and positive volume checks
shell preserves outer width depth and height in the tested inward-thickness case
deterministic oversized-fillet preflight rejection before kernel invocation
FCStd persistence of R002 fillet chamfer and shell objects with OLE IDs selector provenance and CAD authority
STEP export for R002 fillet chamfer and shell
Blender metric selector/provenance readback and save/reopen authority preservation

selector_contract.SELECTOR::VERTICAL_STRAIGHT_OUTER_EDGES: two-vertex straight edge; XY endpoint delta approximately zero; Z span equals authoritative solid height
selector_contract.SELECTOR::TOP_PLANAR_FACE: unique zero-Z-span face on ZMax boundary with positive-Z planar normal

invalidation_rule: Material changes to the stable selector rules, fillet/chamfer/thickness operation semantics, rebuild dimensions, Blender readback, FreeCAD/OCCT version or Blender version require a new bounded integration receipt.
authority_note: This validates one stable-selector bounded Direct B-Rep route. It does not establish persistent topological naming, face-level push/pull, broad robustness or P0-B PASS.
